name: Mansion Days
source:
You’ve hit a rough patch with money and need somewhere to stay. An old friend offers you a room in her family’s big, beautiful house. Inside live four women, each with their own personality and daily rhythm.

Your days are filled with conversations, small adventures, and warm or funny moments. As time passes, you become closer and discover what it truly means to share a home.

[From [url=https://brimddy.itch.io/mansion-days]Itch.io[/url]]
